entry_points.text: EL10 tries hardware, on failure without S1 perm or access fault recognized by PAR FSTYPE with S2 clear runs software walk that may request restart, then writes PAR_EL1.

EL2 adjusts virt controls toggling nested bits around hardware then restores, replaying in software on non-perm failure; combined rewrites to S1, runs it, then walks nested S2 and merges direction-checked result into PAR.
Generic translate grants full rights when S1 off else walks and derives perms; level search maps interruption to level, clean finish to not-found, else error.
Ownership request ignored when host owns debug else records guest ownership and refreshes, with guarded host and guest states; OS lock updates guest view then reloads vCPU on current CPU.
Host TRBE enable and disable act only when mode and context allow; EL1 trace writes direct with VHE else stages with diverged flag, suppressing on protected, uninit or preemptible context.

exports.text: In-dossier AT emulation for EL10, EL2 and combined stages via helpers taking vCPU, selector and VA.
In-dossier generic S1 translator filling caller walk state and level finder for VA and IPA pairs.

hazards.text: Slow-walk concurrency retries whole op; missing nested S2 forces failure PAR to software; switching needs IRQs off; bad selectors warn plus fail; level search warns if S1 off.
SME, SPE and TRBE secondary checks read host SMPS, FDS, FnE and MPAM not guest view, noted for future guest use.
TRBE access forbidden in protected, pre-init, suppressed or preemptible context, last with one-time diagnostic.
HPMN check outside PMU families asserts against VM then handles locally.
Virt SRE state is RAO and WI handled locally without outer enable, fixing guest view.
Injection header lacks in-range entries; ignoring direction or omitting TRFCR_EL1, TRCOSLAR, PMCR_EL0, PMSWINC_EL0 and OSLAR_EL1 write exceptions can mistrap.

invariants.text: Indirect index from descriptor; EL10 PIR_EL1/PIRE0_EL1, EL20 PIR_EL2/PIRE0_EL2, EL2 PIR_EL2 with unpriv denied; 4b values to RWX with W=>R, X subset, one sets XN-write, several deny all, priv-X plus unpriv-W collapses both; override is high-bit clear plus overlay enable.

Overlay index from mask; priv POR_EL1/EL2 by regime, unpriv POR_EL0 for EL10/EL20 else denied; outside allowance means none; NXW plus overlay-X clears overlay-W; intersect only on override; pipeline base, hier limits, overlay, fallback XN, PAN.

Feature needs test guest ID view with boolean combos over NV levels, RAS, CSV2, syndromes, endian, MTE, auth, VMID and EL3; PMU needs exact version rejecting IMPDEF; LPA needs 52b or missing granule; macros bind feature to ID field plus minimum level.
General, debug with trace and PMU, and instruction traps gate by owning extension with core baselines never trapped; all AMU read bits share one gate.

HCR, HCRX, SCTLR2, TCR2, SCTLR EL1 and EL2, MDCR, VTCR and ICH rows gate by owner with baselines and RES masks; EL2 SCTLR and TCR2 add E2H conditioning; each ICH read, write and instr group shares one gate.

Coarse groups split into single, combo and callback ranges; singles bind one control with masked expectation and R, W or bidir forwarding; combos are short terminated lists; complex groups delegate to per-group vCPU callbacks.

Timer enables use sanitized view, local when enable set else forward RW; NV2 guest is HCR E2H plus NV2 plus NV set with TGE plus NV1 clear; NV redirect forwards only when NV2 plus CNTHCTL redirect both hold; table indexed by cond minus base dispatches seven checks.

CPTR maps to CPACR view when E2H clear, forwards on TTA; HPMN decodes counter from encoding or selector, forwarding hyp-owned incl EL0; HCR NV without NVTGE forwards when nested active and NVTGE clear.

Builders feed boot table mapping EL1/EL0 ID, cache, TLB, AT, MM, errors, PA keys, PMU/debug and broad NV for EL2/S2/aliases to coarse cats, with BP/WP plus claim/auth to TDE/TDA, lock/power to TDE/TDOSA, ROM to TDE/TDRA, BRBE/sampling/trace splits, AMU TAM, CPACR TCPAC, TTA interval, timer splits, FPMR HCRX and ICC G0/G1/control/deactivate.

Fine groups general, alias/mask, instr, debug; NS TLBI adds XS filter; bits shared; read full, write diffs only; BP/WP and SPMU capped at sixteen; binary zero for branch/gen2/ICC here, one for PMU/trace/debug/lock/claim/gen1-write/AMU, meaning undefined.
Depends on outside bit, mask, guard, SRCU, preempt, CPU, warning, bug and utility helpers; internals not read.

locks.text: Fast translate holds MMU lock write with IRQs saved across sysreg and S2 switch and hardware op, restoring before release.
Slow, combined S2 and level-search walks run under VM SRCU read, explicit in slow path and scoped elsewhere.
OS-lock reload disables preemption across put and load.

state_machines.text: EL10 starts with fast hardware; on qualifying failure runs software walk that may request restart; final value stored to guest PAR.
Combined maps selectors to S1 R or W, runs S1, early-exits on S1 fail or single stage, else builds IPA, walks nested S2, synthesizes perm fault on direction mismatch and merges PAR.
Slow derives regime, records unpriv and PAN, preps walk, short-circuits when off, else walks, computes perms, checks R or W with address ops passing, marks level-coded fault and builds PAR.
Level search picks regime, filtered walk comparing masked addrs at granularity, match interrupts; EINTR to level, clean to not-found, else error.

structs.text: Row is bits or trap masks plus flags plus ID locator or VM predicate; descriptor holds name and maps plus size; flags 0 never-trap,1 call,2 force-RES,3 masks-ptr,4 as-1,5 req-E2H1,6 1-on-E2H0,7 1-on-E2H1.
Search state holds IPA plus level; perm indices are 4b; combined IPA is S1 output bits 47 to 12 plus orig 11 to 0.
Trap descriptor holds control selector, policy, expected value and mask; disposition 0 local, R bit, W bit, both bidir, plus higher EL0-effect bit.
Trap config is 64b with coarse 10, fine 4, filter 5, reg index 10, bitnum 6, polarity 1, reserved 27 and MBZ 1; entries bind start and end encodings to config plus line.
Filter none, XS-cond, count last; rows bind start/end to group, bit, polarity, filter plus line; polarity 0 negated 1 direct; selectors HDFGRTR/2, HDFGWTR/2, HAFGRTR, ICH read, symbolic only.
Identity is fine traps for general, debug, instr and AMU plus gen2, HCR and SCTLR2; reserved uses never-trap, always-1, E2H-conditional and forced markers.
